data.name: Daile
data.gender_notes: Daile is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'daele', meaning 'opulent', 'rich' or 'God's wealth'. In Christian tradition, it can also symbolize the richness of God's grace and love. The name Daile carries the meaning “God's opulent” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Daile usually hope their child will grow to embody god's opulent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Daile belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's opulent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daile total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: דילה
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נשמה של רצון האל; מקור עברי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם הנשמה "דילה" היא שם עברי שמשמעותו "רצון האל". ראשי תיבות "ד.א.ל". השם עומד בקשר לפסוק "וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים לְאַדָּם, 'בּוֹאוּ, ׀ תִּרְע֥וּ בְגַן־עֵדֶןָ,' וַיִּרְע֣וּ אִתּ֗וֹ אֶת־הָאֲדָמָ֤ה בִּגְנֵי֙ עֵדֶן֙ כְּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ֔.

in_greek.name: Δάιλε
in_greek.meaning: ονομασία που σχετίζεται με την προθυμία και την ευχαρίστηση
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Δάιλε προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη δαίλεω, που σημαίνει "να ευχαριστώ". Σχετίζεται με την προθυμία και την ευχαρίστηση. Στη Νέα Διαθήκη δεν υπάρχει αναφορά σε αυτό το όνομα.

in_latin.name: Daile
in_latin.meaning: nomen significans voluntatem Dei et placiditatem
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomine "Daile" significatur voluntas Dei et placiditas. Non est nomen biblicum, sed potius nomen quod derivatur ab nomine Hebraeo "Dila". Historice, nomen hoc usus est in Ecclesia Christiana a saeculis XIX et XX, ut nomen pro infantibus et puellis natis.

in_english.name: Daile
in_english.meaning: name meaning willing of God and peacefulness, derived from Hebrew root
in_english.long_meaning: The name Daile is derived from the Hebrew root "Dila" meaning "willing of God" and "peacefulness". It has no direct biblical reference, but it is used in Christian tradition as a name for infants and girls born in the 19th and 20th centuries. The name conveys a sense of peacefulness and willingness to serve God.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Daile' may have originated from the Latin word 'daele', which in ancient times was associated with wealth, prosperity, and high social status. Over time, this meaning evolved and the name became popular among Christians, who saw the name as a reminder of the riches and blessings that come from God.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name 'Daile' holds a deeper and more spiritual meaning. It can symbolize the spiritual wealth and richness that comes from a close relationship with God. As the name suggests, a Christian named 'Daile' may be seen as someone who is filled with the abundance of God's grace and love. This name can serve as a reminder to constantly seek God's guidance and blessings, and to cultivate a life that reflects the wealth of God's love and mercy.
data.spiritual_symbolism: A name like Daile in Christianity can be interpreted as 'the one who endures' or 'the one who perseveres'. It's a reminder to keep pushing forward in faith, even when the journey seems long and difficult. Let your strength and resilience reflect the name you bear.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Daile is mentioned in the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle as a female name. The name Daile carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Daile was a common female name in medieval England, particularly in the West Midlands region.
